title: Piling up will not satisfy hunger
summary: Worldly accumulation cannot quiet the deeper hunger of the self. Choose the profit that can still travel.
takeaway: Choose the profit that can still travel.
lifeApplication: At the cart, the fridge, or the late-night scroll, stop before taking more in. Ask whether you are answering a need or trying to fill a hunger that objects cannot touch.

source.shortMeaning: Worldly accumulation cannot quiet the deeper hunger of the self.
source.lifeApplication: Before adding more, ask if the hunger is spiritual, emotional, or simply impulsive.

evidence.coreClaim: Worldly accumulation cannot quiet the deeper hunger of the self.
evidence.turn: Truth is not won by pressure or wit, but by walking in Hukam.
